end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals; easy questions were right, but a why or new-situation question is still to check.
Practised numbers with zeros inside and expanded form; this is still building.
Diya joined spoken number parts together and sometimes left out the zero for an empty place.
Diya gave reasons for using zero in some examples, but the mix-up was still present at the last turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value, reading and writing 4-digit numbers, and using zeros in numbers such as 4,050. Diya got the easy reading-and-writing questions right and tried to explain why the zero is needed, but they still sometimes joined spoken parts or left out the empty-place zero; this was not corrected by the end. At home, practise a few numbers such as 4,050 and 6,007 by saying each place—thousands, hundreds, tens, ones—and then writing the expanded form.
